description: Test suite for WebSocketBasicStream in the Chromium project, including tests for frame parsing, reading, writing, and buffer management in WebSocket streams.

classes.name: StrictStaticSocketDataProvider
classes.description: A subclass of StaticSocketDataProvider that enforces all expected socket I/O data is actually read or written.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSocketTest
classes.description: Test fixture for WebSocketBasicStream socket operations, including setup and utility functions.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSocketSingleReadTest
classes.description: Test fixture for single read operations on WebSocketBasicStream.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSocketChunkedReadTest
classes.description: Test fixture for chunked read operations on WebSocketBasicStream.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSocketWriteTest
classes.description: Test fixture for write operations on WebSocketBasicStream.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSwitchTest
classes.description: Test fixture for buffer size management in WebSocketBasicStream.

methods.name: MakeTransportSocket
methods.description: Creates a mock transport socket with specified read/write data.

methods.name: SetHttpReadBuffer
methods.description: Sets the initial HTTP read buffer with provided data.

methods.name: CreateStream
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketBasicStream for testing with specified socket data.

methods.name: CreateRead
methods.description: Prepares a single mock read for testing.

methods.name: CreateChunkedRead
methods.description: Prepares a chunked read split into multiple parts for testing.

methods.name: PrepareWriteFrame
methods.description: Prepares a WebSocket frame for writing tests.

methods.name: MicrosecondsFromStart
